# meok-stripe-acp-checkout-mcp

> MEOK Stripe ACP Checkout MCP — ChatGPT shopping bridge. Issues + verifies + signs Stripe Agentic Commerce Protocol checkout intents. AP2 mandate crosswalk + PSD2 SCA enforcement. By MEOK AI Labs.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- list_acp_catalogue
- create_checkout_intent
- verify_intent_against_mandate
- request_delegated_payment
- emit_signed_receipt
- list_acp_partners

## Install
```
pip install meok-stripe-acp-checkout-mcp
```

- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/meok-stripe-acp-checkout-mcp/
